rows.label: tlk70000041_01_msg0001
rows.name:
Man, there's really not much to do
when you're guarding a warehouse on
the edge of the city... Ho hum.

rows.label: tlk70000041_01_msg0002
rows.name:
Hm? This warehouse belongs to the
royal palace. Don't come any closer,
all right?

rows.label: tlk70000041_01_msg0003
rows.name:
But since you've come all this way and
I'm bored too, I'll tell you something
interesting.

rows.label: tlk70000041_01_msg0004
rows.name:
Apparently this warehouse dates back
to the reign of the king before the
previous king of Iira.

rows.label: tlk70000041_01_msg0005
rows.name:
There's even a rumor that something
incredible is hidden right beneath
it...

rows.label: tlk70000041_01_msg0006
rows.name:
It's been expanded and rebuilt so many
times that it looks almost the same as
all the other buildings from outside.
